book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Bhahengalihengo mu ngonda wa Mizabibu
“Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde ulengana na mundu joabhi na ngonda wa mizabibu joakabhokiki lukela pachibhombu kubhapeleka bhahengalihengu mungonda waki.
Akajongini nabhu kwa kubhalepa chipandi chimu cha madini gha feza kwa lichobha, na akabhapeliki kungonda wa mizabibu.
Pajahikiki saa tatu ja lukela, akabhokiki kabheti na akabhahimani bhandu bhangi bhajemiki paligulio bhanga na lihengu.
Akabhapwaghile, ‘Njendanyaje na mwenga mkahenga lihengu mungonda wangu wa mizabibu, na nepani ananundepa ngati mokupalakila.’ Na bhombi bhakapiti.
Pajahikiki saa sita ja muhi na saa tisa pakamihi, akabhokiki kabheti na kutenda bhelabhela.

Pajahikiki saa komi na moja pakamihi akabhokiki kabheti na akabhahimanili bhandu bhangi bhajemiki pandu paligulio pala. Akabhalalukile, ‘Bho, mbona njemiki pambane muhi jokapi panga na kuhenga lihengo?’
Bhakamuyangiki, ‘Maghambu njeta mundu joatupeki lihengo.’ Akabhapwaghile, ‘Na mwehapa nanamu njendanyaje mkahenga lihengo mu ngonda wangu wa mizabibu.’

“Pakwahikiki pakamihi, mweni ngonda jola akandohiki njemalela wa bhahengalihengo bhala, na kumpwaghila, ‘Ubhalohaje bhahengalihengo na ubhalepaye mbija yabhu, ukatumbula na bhakujomukela na kujomulela na bhakutumbula.’
Pabhakahikiki bhala bha saa kumi na moja, kila jumu wabhu akapatiki chipandi chimu cha madini gha feza.
Bhala bhabhakatumbwi kuhenga lihengo pabhakahikiki, bhahambukya anaabhalepa nakanopi, nambu kila jumu wabhu akapatiki chipandi chimu cha madini gha feza.
Bhandu bhala bhakajopiki mbiya yabhu, na bhakatumbwi kung'ong'utakela mweni ngonda,

bhakapwaghaje, ‘Bhandu bha kujomukela abhabha bhahengiki lihengu kwa lisaa limu pena, nambu bho, maghambu kiki wehapa wapeki malepu kulengana na tepani tetuhengiki lihengu lelinonwipi na kujochakeka na lyobha muhi jokapi?’
“Mweni ngonda jola akamuyangiki jumu waki, ‘Nkoche, ngachenukuponjiki chindo. Bho, ngachetukajongini kubha anauhenga lihengu kwa chipandi chimu cha madini gha feza?
Utola mbiya jaku ujendaje. Mbala kumpekeha wa kujomukela ajoju kulengana na wehapa.
Bho, ngacheniweza kuhenga chenichipala na hindu yangu namwete? Au bho, umonela wihu kwa ndandi nepani wambone?’ ”
Yesu akajomuli kwa kupwagha, “Bhelabhela wa kujomukela anaakubha wa kutumbula, na wa kutumbula, anaakubha wa kujomukela.”
Yesu alongela mala ja katatu malobhi gha kupotela kwaki
Yesu paakabhi akwela kujenda ku Yelusalemu, akabhalohiki bhabhulwa bhaki komi na bhabheli bhala, na pabhakabhi bhajenda mwindela, akabhapwaghile,
“Njowanyaje, tujenda ku Yelusalemu, na konihoku Mwana waka Mundu anajeghalika mu mabhoku gha bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia. Na bhombi anabhuntemula kupotela,
anabhumboha kwa bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude, nahuli bhundongamaje, na kundapu iboku, na kumuwamba panani pa msalaba, nambu lichobha la katatu anahyokaje kabheti.”
Amabhu andobha Yesu
Panihapa mabhu wabhu bhana bhaka Zebedayo akanjendi Yesu papamu na bhana bhaki, akachikimi palongi jaki, na kundobha anhengila chela cheachipala.

Yesu akandalukile, “Bho, upala kike?” Amabhu hoju akampwaghile, “Pepakoku, laghalakya kubha bhana bhangu bhabheli abhabha bhatama jumu upambala waku wa kumalelelu, na jumu upambala waku wa kumangeja, mu Ukolongwa waku.”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Ngachemmanyi chemuchilobha. Bho, muweza kunywele chikombi cheananywelila nenga, na kubatizwa ubatizo ghonibatizwe?” Bhakamuyangiki, “Tuweza.”

Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Chakaka ananywelilaje chikombi changu, na kubatizwa ubatizo ghonibatizwe, nambu kutama chiwoku changu cha kumalelelu na chiwoku changu cha kumangeja nga lihengu langu kumpekeha, nambu lijambu heli anabhapekiwa bhala bhabhabhekakiwi tayali na Atati wangu.”
Bhabhulwa bhangi komi bhala pabhakajowini ghanihagha, bhakabhayomile bhalongu bhabheli bhala.

Nambu Yesu akabhalohiki bhabhulwa bhaki papamu, na kubhapwaghila, “Mmanyi kubha bhatawala bha bhandu bhangakubha Bhayahude bhajemalela bhandu bhabhu kwa makili, na ihongozi habha bhahenga bhandu habha kubha bhabhu.
Nambu kwinu mwenga ngakwikubha bhenibhela, nambu mundu jokapi joapala kubha nkolongwa kwinu, impalika abya mtumika winu.
Joapala kubha wa kutumbula pachilanda jinu, ipalika abya mtumika winu,
maghambu Mwana waka Mundu ngacheahikiki nahuli kutumikiwa, nambu kutumika, na kuubhoha womi waki nahuli kubhakombola bhandu bhamaheli.”
Yesu abhalamiha akangalola bhabheli
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki pabhakabhi bhabhoka ku Yeliko, lipogha likolongwa la bhandu, bhakunjengalile.
Akangalola bhabheli bhabhakabhi bhatemi punkeghi ja indela, na pabhakajowini kubha Yesu apeta, bhakajamalili, “Bambo, Mwana waka Daude, utubhonila chiha!”
Lipogha la bhandu lela lakabhalakalili na kubhapwaghila mtumbalaje, nambu akangalola bhala bhakajonjuki kujamalila nakanopi, bhakapwaghaje, “Bambo, Mwana waka Daude, utubhonila chiha!”
Yesu akajemiki, na kubhaloha na kubhalalukila, “Bho, mpala nuntendila kike?”
Bhakamuyangiki, “Bambo, tupala kulola.”
Yesu akabhabhoni chiha, akaghapapihi mihu ghabhu, na palapala bhakapatiki kulola, na bhakanjengalile.
